name: Stormbringer: Cyclone's Recharge shortens Kiss of the Clouds on Shock, Gale and Electrocute (#1771)
contract: Cyclone's Recharge 300827 (Spell.dbc: passive Attributes 448, Effect[0] APPLY_AURA / aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL, EffectTriggerSpell 300828, TARGET_UNIT_CASTER) promises "Casting Shock, Gale or Electrocute now reduces the remaining cooldown of your Kiss of the Clouds by $/1000;300828s1 sec". 300828 has one SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN with EffectBasePoints -1001 + EffectDieSides 1 = -1000 ms and EffectMiscValue 500039 Kiss of the Clouds. 300827's DBC ProcFlags are 0, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skips it (SpellMgr.cpp: "if (!spellInfo->ProcFlags) continue;") and no spell_proc row existed, leaving the aura with no entry in mSpellProcMap: it can never fire. Even once it fires, Player::ModifySpellCooldown keys the cooldown map by the exact EffectMiscValue id, so the named rank 1 (500039) is not the rank a level-80 player casts: Kiss of the Clouds is a 9-rank chain (spell_ranks first_spell_id 500039, rank 9 = 501449) with Category 56 and CategoryRecoveryTime 30000, and the category stores an entry for every rank. The three sources are identified by SpellFamilyName 22 masks over the 953 family-22 spells: Shock 0x800 (9 ranks), Gale 0x4000 (5 ranks), Electrocute 0x2000000 (13 ranks); Call Lightning (SpellFamilyFlags1 0x10, SpellFamilyFlags0 0) is outside all three and is the negative control. An identical unarmed control player casts the same spells in lockstep so ordinary cooldown decay cancels out. All three ranks of Electrocute checked in this batch (501421, 501432, 801844) carry Spell.dbc TargetAuraState 13 (AURA_STATE_HEALTHLESS_35_PERCENT), so it only lands on a target already below 35% health; the fixture drops both dummies to 30% before the Electrocute casts so the spell is not rejected with SPELL_FAILED_TARGET_AURASTATE before the on-cast proc phase ever runs.
